---
title: "Toy market dashboard"
format: dashboard
---

```{python}
#| include: false
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "src")

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from market_demo import generate_prices, log_returns, estimate_parameters, simulate_gbm

prices = generate_prices()
returns = log_returns(prices)
estimates = estimate_parameters(returns)
paths = simulate_gbm(
    initial_price=float(prices.iloc[0]),
    n_days=len(returns),
    drift=estimates["drift"],
    volatility=estimates["volatility"],
)
```

## Prices and returns {height=40%}

### Price history

```{python}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 4))
ax.plot(prices.index, prices, color="#2878B5", linewidth=1.2, label="Synthetic history")
ax.set(title="Synthetic closing price", xlabel="Date", ylabel="Price")
ax.grid(alpha=0.25)
ax.legend(frameon=False)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

### Return distribution

```{python}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 4))
ax.hist(returns, bins=40, density=True, color="#59A14F", alpha=0.8)
ax.set(title="Daily log-return distribution", xlabel="Daily log return", ylabel="Density")
ax.grid(alpha=0.2)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Calibrated simulation {height=40%}

```{python}
median = paths.median(axis=1)
lower = paths.quantile(0.05, axis=1)
upper = paths.quantile(0.95, axis=1)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 4))
ax.fill_between(paths.index, lower, upper, color="#F28E2B", alpha=0.22, label="Simulated 5th–95th percentile")
ax.plot(paths.index, median, color="#E15759", label="Simulated median")
ax.plot(range(len(prices)), prices.to_numpy(), color="#2878B5", linewidth=1.2, label="Synthetic history")
ax.set(title="History compared with calibrated GBM", xlabel="Trading day", ylabel="Price")
ax.legend(frameon=False)
ax.grid(alpha=0.25)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

### Interpretation

This dashboard is a compact view of the same reproducible example used in the
[narrative report](analysis.qmd). The data are synthetic and are not a forecast.
